Using the correct division:

\[
4x^2+8x+13 = (1+x)(4x+4)+9
\]

So for \(x>0\),

\[
y=\frac{(1+x)(4x+4)+9}{6(1+x)}
=\frac{4x+4}{6}+\frac{9}{6(1+x)}
=\frac{2}{3}(x+1)+\frac{3}{2(1+x)}.
\]

Let \(t=x+1>1\). Then

\[
y=\frac{2}{3}t+\frac{3}{2t}.
\]

By AM-GM,

\[
\frac{2}{3}t+\frac{3}{2t} \ge 2\sqrt{\frac{2}{3}t\cdot \frac{3}{2t}}=2.
\]

Equality when

\[
\frac{2}{3}t=\frac{3}{2t}
\implies t^2=\frac94
\implies t=\frac32,
\]

which is valid since \(t>1\). Therefore the minimum value is

\[
\boxed{2}
\]
